A1.name: label QC and metering reconstruction
A1.current: hourly kpx_group_* taken as given; 10-min SCADA used only to build pc_true

A2.name: availability / outage / curtailment identification
A2.current: per-row gate deficit >= 0.05 drops calibration rows; block structure (lag-1 autocorrelation 0.90) is not used

A3.name: power-curve estimation and the teacher target
A3.current: one 4-parameter curve per group, x^k form, no storm-control region, integrated over per-turbine 10-min wind
A3.notes: SCADA-only power curve: UNISON turbine power directly, VESTAS by quantile mapping f(v)=Q_P(F_V(v)) since its power is permutation/sign corrupted but value-intact. The meter never enters the objective. Note it is WORSE against the meter (MAE 0.05350 vs pc_true 0.04804) and better downstream -- consistent with R7.

A4.name: target transformation and support
A4.current: raw capacity factor in [0,1]; classifier discretises to 26 bins of width 0.04

B1.name: grid-to-site reduction
B1.current: inverse-distance weighting on horizontal distance, plus box order statistics
B1.notes: per-source reduction: LDAPS most-exposed cell, GFS inverse distance. Verified on measured hub wind (LDAPS max 0.8405 vs idw 0.8076; GFS idw 0.7075 vs max 0.5238, the ordering inverts). A REPLACEMENT, so no dilution tax. Contribution below the seed floor but free.

B2.name: vertical extrapolation to hub height
B2.current: fixed power-law and two-point log-law from 10/50 m (LDAPS) and 80/100 m (GFS)
B2.notes: supervised hub-wind transfer: a model trained against the MEASURED SCADA hub wind (26,304 hourly joins) supplies hub__ws_pred. The single largest verified stage gain in this project. This cluster had been done entirely unsupervised.

B3.name: systematic bias correction / MOS of the NWP fields
B3.current: none as a preprocessing step; the learner absorbs bias implicitly

B4.name: terrain and micro-siting adjustment
B4.current: geometric block and G2 encoding; no DEM, no exposure index

B5.name: multi-source combination
B5.current: LDAPS and GFS columns concatenated into one matrix

C1.name: atmospheric regime and stability representation
C1.current: atm__ block: shear exponents, bulk Richardson proxy, theta gradients, BLH

C2.name: temporal structure within the issuance
C2.current: lag/lead +-1,2,3 and +-6 h, batch anomaly and rank

C3.name: dimensionality and feature selection
C3.current: 872 columns, top-150 by teacher gain, colsample 0.4; no FDR control

D1.name: point estimator
D1.current: LightGBM L2 teacher on pc_true, then a downstream learner
D1.notes: LightGBM 4.7 extra_trees + path_smooth + feature_fraction_bynode, never switched on before. Helps the point estimator; HURTS the density (S15-N9/N10).

D2.name: conditional distribution estimator
D2.current: 26-class DART multiclass softmax over discretised capacity factor

D3.name: calibration of the predictive distribution
D3.current: a temperature exponent T inside the decision grid; no separate calibration step

D4.name: multi-task / hierarchical structure across the three groups
D4.current: pooled fit with group one-hots; no partial pooling
D4.notes: metric-matched group weights w_g=(1/3)/share_g. Pruned by reverse ablation, consistent with the complete-pooling result of S14-N9 and with S13-N5.

E1.name: action selection under the settlement metric
E1.current: argmax of an expected-utility surface over a 0.0025 action grid, (T,G) chosen fold-outside

E2.name: combination across members
E2.current: 0.30 * D + 0.70 * DEPAVG, an average of four ACTIONS

E3.name: constraints and post-processing
E3.current: per-group soft cap {0.985, 0.989, 1.005}; clip to [0, cap]

F1.name: validation design
F1.current: dev-2023 Q2/Q3/Q4 expanding window -- CONTAINS NO WINTER, while the graded period is all of 2025

F2.name: model selection and arbitration
F2.current: paired moving-block bootstrap plus a Model Confidence Set (arch 8.0.0)
